items.title: What to make of NFL Week 11 -- including wins for the Jets and 49ers: Our reporters break down every game
items.summary: Our NFL Nation reporters react to all the action, answering the biggest questions coming out of each Sunday game. Here's what we learned from Week 11.

items.title: The Joe Brady difference in Buffalo? Judging big overreactions from Sunday's games
items.summary: Is an NFC East three-peat still in play in Philly? We overreact to Week 11 NFL action.

items.title: 49ers lose RT McKivitz for season after serious ankle injury vs. Vikings
items.summary: 49ers right tackle Colton McKivitz suffered what is believed to be a fractured and dislocated left ankle during Sunday night's 35-10 win against the Vikings, according to coach Kyle Shanahan.

items.title: Frustrated Saleh calls Titans' effort 'disgusting, embarrassing football'
items.summary: Titans coach Robert Saleh couldn't hide his frustration when he stepped to the podium after Sunday's 51-30 loss to the Cowboys.

items.title: Giants' Skattebo surprises with backflip: 'I have to bring the juice'
items.summary: Cam Skattebo's pledge to nix his trademark backflip didn't last long. Not even a week.

items.title: Purdy beats Vikings blitz as 49ers say QB 'best player in the game right now'
items.summary: Quarterback Brock Purdy heard "MVP" chants in Mexico City and continued to earn praise from his teammates as he led the 49ers to a statement victory against the top-ranked Vikings defense on Sunday night

items.title: No-TD call for WR Washington in Jaguars' loss was correct, NFL says
items.summary: The NFL said Sunday that on-field officials were correct in ruling that Parker Washington did not make a critical touchdown catch in the fourth quarter.

items.title: Steelers Metcalf ejected for trying to poke Eagles' DeJean in eye
items.summary: Steelers wide receiver DK Metcalf was ejected in the third quarter of Sunday's game against the Eagles for unsportsmanlike conduct.

items.title: Payton awards game ball to Tom Jackson's family as Broncos honor Hall of Famer
items.summary: The Broncos will send a game ball to the wife and daughters of Tom Jackson after the "Orange Crush" great died Friday at age 75.

items.title: Despite loss, Mendoza 'felt more comfortable' in 2nd start for Raiders
items.summary: Fernando Mendoza, making his second start for the Raiders, had good and bad moments Sunday at Denver. He completed 18 of 37 passes for 267 yards and three touchdowns but was sacked five times and pressured 16 times, and threw a game-sealing pick-six.

items.title: 👀 Bills poke fun at Dolphins with Grand Theft Auto VI post, leading Week 11 trolls
items.summary: NFL teams remained petty in Week 11, led by a petty post from the Buffalo Bills.

items.title: 49ers run roughshod over Vikings in Mexico City, maintain top-seed position in NFC
items.summary: 49ers used a late second-quarter burst to take control of game in Mexico City and move to 9-1 on the season.

items.title: Cowboys put up points, no rushing attempts for Allen: Week 11's winners and losers
items.summary: Dak Prescott, CeeDee Lamb and Jonah Coleman put fantasy teams on their backs in Week 11, while Josh Allen, Jonathan Taylor and Tony Pollard disappointed.

items.title: Buzz: Leading fantasy scorers for Week 11 through Sunday's early games
items.summary: A closer look at the top 10 fantasy scorers in Week 11, including Cowboys QB Dak Prescott.

items.title: What ESPN Analytics says about Jags going for two, kicking a field goal down eight
items.summary: The Jaguars made it 23-15 late vs. the Giants, but their two-point try failed. They got the ball back ... but kicked a field goal, leaving them down 23-18?

items.title: 49ers' Bosa booed in Mexico after fan comments
items.summary: 49ers defensive end Nick Bosa was heavily booed on Sunday night by fans at Estadio Azteca, a few days after his comments about Mexican crowd behavior during a 2022 game sparked outrage in the country.

items.title: Prescott stays hot, salutes offense after 51-point day: 'It's all working'
items.summary: Dak Prescott completed 28 of 33 passes for 325 yards with four TDs, no interceptions and a rushing score in the Cowboys' 51-30 win against the Titans.

items.title: 'Locked into the moment,' Young rallies first-place Panthers past Ravens
items.summary: In a back-and-forth game laced with lead changes, Bryce Young rallied the Panthers to a 35-33 home win over the Baltimore Ravens on Sunday at Bank of America Stadium, a second straight victory for the 5-5 Panthers that padded lead in the NFC South.

items.title: Bears' Simmons lauded as 'momentum changer' after notching 3 sacks in win
items.summary: Jeffery Simmons recorded three sacks in the Bears' 21-13 win over the Saints on Sunday, which tied his single-game career high.

items.title: Kelce pads Hall of Fame résumé with two first-half TDs in Chiefs' win
items.summary: Travis Kelce passed Rob Gronkowski for third place for the most total touchdowns, including playoffs, by a tight end in league history.

items.title: Brady not satisfied with 9-1 Bills, says team wasn't looking ahead to Chiefs
items.summary: Joe Brady said he isn't close to satisfied despite his Bills beating the Dolphins to move to 9-1.

items.title: Chargers QB Herbert lands in concussion protocol
items.summary: Quarterback Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol, the Chargers said after Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets in Inglewood, California.

items.title: For Broncos players, McMillian pick-6 latest reason to keep CB long term
items.summary: After Ja'Quan McMillian made a one-handed, 35-yard pick-six Sunday, his teammates surrounded him with a pay-the-man, count-that-money celebration.

items.summary: Tennessee was fined $250,000 by the SEC after fans threw golf balls and mustard bottles onto the football field late during Saturday's win over LSU.

items.title: TCU fires coach Dykes just months after multiyear extension
items.summary: TCU has fired coach Sonny Dykes, who led the Horned Frogs to an appearance in the 2023 CFP title game in his first season.

items.title: Sources: Florida State's coaching search focused on Georgia DC Schumann
items.summary: Florida State's coaching search is focused on Georgia defensive coordinator Glenn Schumann, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel and Andrea Adelson.

items.title: Sources: Irish lose Talich to torn Achilles
items.summary: Notre Dame starting safety Luke Talich sustained a torn right Achilles tendon in Saturday's win against SMU, sources told ESPN.

items.summary: Wake Forest defensive coordinator Scottie Hazelton has signed a contract extension.

items.title: Montana State top seed for FCS playoffs; 5-7 LIU sneaks in as conference champ
items.summary: Defending national champion Montana State received the top seed for the 24-team FCS playoffs, while Northeast Conference champion LIU (5-7) became the first playoff team with a losing record since 2017.
